reviews.review_msg: Dr. Mike is awesome!!! Very clear prof on what's to be expected of the course and guidelines for exams. He's super easy to approach, makes himself very open and available for you with content help, and just overall good at explaining the material. Thought organic chemistry was gonna be hard, but he definitely made it easy to follow.
Best prof ever. Super easy to reach out to, lots of office hours. Problem sets and practice midterms very similar to midterms and final exam.

He's great at explaining concepts, his practice exams mirror the format and questions on the actual exams, gives a lot of partial marks so try all of the questions. Lectures are recorded but go to lecture to recieve the free iclicker marks. Mike is the goat take courses with him if you see him as the prof.

He is great! If you can take a class with him, do it!!!! He is very knowledgeable, and if you study and stay on top of the material, you will do great. He knows a lot and is always willing to help. He is also very accommodating and genuinely wants his students to succeed. Great teacher and great professor overall!

Genuinely the best prof I've encountered at SFU so far! Super kind and helpful, offers lots of pre-exam office hours, interesting lecturer, and exams are based on problem set and quiz questions. Take any course with him if you can!
The best prof I've had at SFU! His lectures and expectations are very straightforward and he makes the class super enjoyable.
One of the best profs I've ever had at SFU! So caring and always replies to emails super fast. Exams are very similar to the practice exams and he is very generous with his grading,
Everything you want in a professor, good lectures, passionate teaching, helpful office hours, and straightforward tests which he gives pretty clear instruction on what to study for them.

genuinely deserves a raise. I had him for chem 281 (organic chem) not 122. Mike is compassionate, caring, and shows intellectual humility. He encourages students to attend office hours, collaborate with each other, and ask questions. He answers questions thoroughly and does an amazing job of explaining difficult concepts. Can't recommend him enough
Best prof ever I had him for 122 and currently taking 281 with him. He is the nicest guy ever and genuinely cares and supports his students. I love him. Michael if ur seeing this I love u thank u

Made me fall in love with chemistry. He's so knowledgeable and genuinely a great guy. His exams are fair and he can actually teach a lecture properly and doesn't have to rely on 50 sets of lecture slides to explain a topic. His office hours are so helpful and possibly one of the reasons I passed this class
